ModMetaData.name: Categorized Cleaning - Split
ModMetaData.author: PeteTimesSix
ModMetaData.description:
Splits the cleaning work type into four:
One for clean rooms (kitchens, hospitals and laboratories) One for indoor cleaning One for a custom cleaning zone you paint yourself (Architect > Zone) One for outdoor cleaning in the home area
Each can be individually prioritized. The mod settings decide which auto-detected room types belong to which column, and you can pin a single room to a column by selecting a colonist and right-clicking inside the room.
